# rom-weaver

> A local-first browser tool for applying and creating ROM patches. Files are processed on-device without uploads or accounts.

## Web app

- [Apply ROM patches](https://rom-weaver.com/apply): Apply patches with format detection, checksum validation, and ordered patch chains.
- [Create ROM patches](https://rom-weaver.com/create): Create patches with format-aware settings and distributable bundles.
- [Documentation](https://rom-weaver.com/docs): Choose browser or CLI usage, find installation and self-hosting, start a guided sample, browse every guide, or read quick answers.
- [Browser usage](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/get-started): Learn patching in the browser with included homebrew files.
- [Apply patches guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/apply-rom-patches): Use the browser's Apply workflow with loose patches, patch chains, archives, or bundles.
- [Create patches guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/create-rom-patches): Compare Original and Modified, create a patch, then test the downloaded artifact.
- [Create bundles guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/create-bundles): Build, download, test, and publish a patch-only bundle in the browser's Apply workflow.
- [FAQ](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/faq): Privacy, ROM matching, formats, bundles, devices, offline use, and browser versus CLI.
- [Compression formats guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/compression-formats): Pick format-specific compression such as CHD, RVZ, or Z3DS, plus ZIP and 7z, and learn when trimming beats compressing.
- [Install the CLI](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/install): Install rom-weaver with package managers, verified scripts, npm, Docker, or from source.
- [CLI get started](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/cli-get-started): Practice Apply, Create, and Bundle in the terminal with the same test assets.
- [CLI reference](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/cli): Every command, global flag, JSON output, exit codes, shell completions, and man pages.
- [Supported formats](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/supported-formats): The full patch, container, codec, checksum, trim, and header support tables.
- [Self-hosting](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/self-hosting): Deploy and configure the static webapp.
- [Architecture](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/architecture): Understand the Rust command core, browser workers, and TypeScript boundary.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/README.md): Choose the guide for using, integrating, deploying, or developing rom-weaver.
- [Browser guides](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/usage/README.md): Browser-first Apply, Create, Bundle, troubleshooting, and FAQ pages.
- [Install the CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/cli/install.md): Package managers, verified install scripts, npm, Docker, and source builds.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/cli/reference.md): Commands, global flags, JSON output, exit codes, permissions, and completions.
- [Supported formats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/reference/formats.md): Patch, container, codec, checksum, trim, and header support tables.
- [Web app integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/hosting/webapp-integration.md): Preloaded URLs and same-origin OPFS integration.
- [Self-hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/hosting/self-hosting.md): Docker, static hosting, reverse proxies, subpaths, HTTPS, and browser isolation headers.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/development/ARCHITECTURE.md): Crate graph, registries, browser workers, OPFS, and the Rust-TypeScript boundary.
- [Release guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/.github/RELEASING.md): Release automation, publishing channels, and retry procedures.

- [Source code](https://github.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver): Source, issues, pull requests, and releases.
